newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila overnight money unchanged, C Bank ups rate.
newsitem.headline: Manila overnight money unchanged, C Bank ups rate.

text.p: Manila overnight money was anchored at an average of 10.28125 percent on Wednesday but rates are expected to rise in line with the Central Bank's adjusted rate, traders said.
The Central Bank decided to lift its overnight borrowing rate by 0.75 percentage-point to 11 percent after the overnight market closed.
"This is a preemptive move. This is just to calm the (foreign exchange) market," Central Bank Treasurer Sergio Edeza told Reuters.
Banks had been edgy over possible outflows from foreign funds divesting from the stock market.
Done rates from the overnight market were at 10.25/10.28125 percent, with 33 lenders and 18 borrowers.
Volume was lower at 17.87 billion pesos from 18.57 billion.
In the secondary market, there was little trading as banks awaited moves of the Central Bank to inject calm in the peso market, traders said.
